coverage.methodology: Scope is the released 2014 Z-Man Games second edition, basic game only. The governing-document denominator contains the one exact-edition official core-rules PDF required for every published rules claim. Included expansions are inventoried only as excluded content. No separate public FAQ or errata authority was found in the bounded official-domain and exact-title checks, and no FAQ/errata-dependent claim is published. Factual coverage counts the twelve declared claim groups in evidence.json; reception opinions and excluded expansions carry zero factual weight.
